How many active community water systems are there in the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS'
Which federal district courts handled the most civil cases in the Federal Judicial Center's database?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_courts.fjc_integrated_database AS f JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = f.district_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much of public school funding came from federal, state and local sources in fiscal 2017?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(greatest(try_cast(tfedrev AS double), 0)) / sum(greatest(try_cast(totalrev AS double), 0)), 1) AS federal_pct, round(100.0 * sum(greatest(try_cast(tstrev AS double), 0)) / sum(greatest(try_cast(totalrev AS double), 0)), 1) AS state_pct, round(100.0 * sum(greatest(try_cast(tlocrev AS double), 0)) / sum(greatest(try_cast(totalrev AS double), 0)), 1) AS local_pct FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17'
What kinds of charter do active FDIC-insured institutions hold?

SELECT CASE bkclass WHEN 'N' THEN 'National bank' WHEN 'SM' THEN 'State member bank' WHEN 'NM' THEN 'State nonmember bank' WHEN 'SB' THEN 'Savings bank' WHEN 'SA' THEN 'Savings association' WHEN 'SL' THEN 'State savings institution' WHEN 'OI' THEN 'Insured branch of a foreign bank' ELSE bkclass END AS charter, count(*) AS institutions FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many particle entries does the Particle Data Group list?
SELECT count(DISTINCT name) AS particles FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgparticle
Which companies are named as applicant on the most published patent applications?
SELECT sorted_raw_org AS organisation, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_sorted_org_not_disambiguated WHERE sorted_raw_org <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the consumer price index for electricity changed over the last ten years?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SEHF01' AND period = 'M13' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10
Which kinds of Clean Water Act permit violations have drawn the most enforcement actions?
SELECT violation_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_violation_enforcements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many published patent applications contributed reactions?
SELECT count(DISTINCT patentnumber) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications
At what hours of the day is New York's electricity demand highest on average?

SELECT hour_number, round(avg(try_cast(demand_mw AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much have benefit plans reported paying insurance brokers in commissions?
SELECT sum(try_cast(ins_broker_comm_pd_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_a_part1
Which parent organisations received the most federal money in the last 12 months?
SELECT recipient_name, try_cast(last_12_months AS double) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_profile WHERE recipient_level = 'P' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did more workers quit their jobs in 2021 than in 2019?

SELECT year, sum(try_cast(value AS double)) AS quits_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_jt_data WHERE series_id = 'JTS000000000000000QUL' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2021') AND period <> 'M13' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which states bought the most electricity at retail in 2020?

SELECT column06 AS state, round(sum(try_cast(sales_4 AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 IN ('A', 'B') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median household income in Kings County, New York, in the 2020 to 2024 American Community Survey?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36047' AND variable = 'B19013_E001'
Which publishers appear most often among Zenodo research records?
SELECT publisher, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many generators are planned to retire, by the operators' own reports?
SELECT count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE trim(planned_retirement_year) <> ''
Which counties produced the largest GDP in 2024?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS gdp_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cagdp2 WHERE linecode = '1' AND geoname LIKE '%, %' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Is more money passed down as sub-grants or as sub-contracts?
SELECT subaward_type, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which SEC forms were filed most often in 2025?
SELECT form, count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings WHERE substr(cast(filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people filed to run for president in 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cand_id) AS candidates FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'P' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2024'
Which investment managers have filed the most 13F holdings reports?
SELECT filingmanager_name, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_coverpage WHERE reporttype = '13F HOLDINGS REPORT' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of 2022's fatal crashes happened after dark?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(lgt_condname LIKE 'Dark%') / count(*), 1) AS pct_dark FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022'
Which drugs carry the highest average pharmacy acquisition cost per unit?
SELECT ndc_description AS drug, max(try_cast(nadac_per_unit AS double)) AS cost_per_unit FROM govblock_health.medicaid_nadac GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average molecular mass of a compound in PubChem?
SELECT avg(try_cast(c2 AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass
Which power plants on the national map have the largest operating capacity?
SELECT name, try_cast(oper_cap AS double) AS capacity_mw FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the longest patent term adjustment the USPTO has granted?
SELECT max(try_cast(patent_term_adjustment AS double)) AS most_days FROM govblock_patents.patex_pta_summary_25
Which institutions have received the most National Science Foundation award dollars?
SELECT name, sum(try_cast(awardamount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did used car and truck prices climb from 2020 to 2022?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SETA02' AND period = 'M13' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2020', '2022') ORDER BY year
Which countries were the biggest buyers of American soybeans in 2023?

SELECT c.cty_name, sum(try_cast(d.all_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_exports_country AS c ON c.cty_code = d.cty_code WHERE d.commodity LIKE '1201%' AND d.year = '2023' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many utility-scale wind turbines are there in Texas?
SELECT count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'TX'
Which metropolitan areas sprawl over the most land?
SELECT name, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_cbsa WHERE cast(cbsa_type AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which sections of California law were amended most recently?
SELECT citation, try_cast(last_amended_year AS integer) AS last_amended FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'ca' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which grades have the most public school students nationwide?

SELECT grade, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
